apify-actor-start.eventDescription: Apify synthetic event, charged automatically once per GB of run memory (1 GB minimum). Kept at Apify's default price; covers the first 5 seconds of compute of every run.

document-converted.eventDescription: Charged once per PDF or DOCX successfully converted (covers download and setup). Failed downloads and unreadable files are never charged.

page-converted.eventDescription: Charged per page converted to Markdown (PDF: actual pages converted; DOCX: page count stored by Word, or 3,000 characters per page if absent). RAG chunking is included at no extra cost.
